subject: How to access remote Hadoop cluster from R-Studio desktop?

messages.author: ed057a78ade0fdbe
messages.subject: How to access remote Hadoop cluster from R-Studio desktop?
parts:
How to set this up? RStudio may be running on a Windows box and wants to access data from Hadoop cluster on remote servers.

Thanks.

messages.author: 63023c771a070260
messages.subject: Re: How to access remote Hadoop cluster from R-Studio desktop?
parts:
You need to install RHadoop for windows and the wiki has instructions on how to do that. It only works with HDP for windows. If the remote cluster is Unix and local is Windows, I can't tell you that's impossible but sure it isn't supported. Then you have to install RStudio for windows. Then you have to configure two env variables and there are some quirks in doing that with RStudio that have been covered multiple times in this group, a search will give you all the answers.


Antonio
